Re-run 17:03. (a) both modes, thrown and 'unreadable': error shown, button back to 'Photograph', nothing saved, Paste works, Photograph retry works — but the error has no role=alert / live region (fails U15). The thrown read shows the raw server text (the mock mimics dev's Vertex 404; the app prints it verbatim). (b) Hospital passes: 'Prior note saved, but extraction failed. Expand it and tap Extract Fields to retry.' (role=alert), note kept; Extract Fields then fills imaging/background with no further tap. The primary-model fallback is proven in-process only (extractPriorNote Haiku ×2 → Mistral, diagnostics row Mistral fellBackFrom Haiku with providerMs); end to end it needs aiProvider:_set (out of bounds), so (b) is partly covered. Nursing Home stores the note with no extraction (Q4, recorded). (c) axe color-contrast (serious) on the panel heading in every state and view; date and note fields labelled only by placeholders; under the matrix's ≥ 24 px size rule the 'Note · <date>' toggle (276×16) and the delete button (21×21) are too small on Pixel 7 / iPhone 15 — but axe's target-size rule (WCAG 2.5.8, which allows the spacing exception) finds 0 violations in every state and view, so this is not a WCAG 2.5.8 failure. No sideways scroll, nothing truncated or covered.
Product issue: (1) A failed photo read is not announced to assistive technology (no role=alert / live region), and when the read service errors the physician reads '[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error Uncaught Error: Vertex AI request failed: 404 …' (TC-13 U15). (2) Previous Notes panel: low-contrast heading (axe color-contrast, WCAG 1.4.3) and placeholder-only labels on the date and note fields (WCAG 1.3.1/3.3.2) — TC-13 S28 oracle. Tap targets under the matrix's 24 px rule (16 px-high toggle, 21 px delete) on phones; axe target-size passes (spacing exception), so this is the matrix's rule, not WCAG 2.5.8. Observation: after a pasted note is saved, a photo read appends to the old text in the paste box (the note appears twice).

descriptionHtml:
Bug B17 · P1 · new

Errors show the raw server message to the physician ('[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] … Server Error … 404')

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-94425 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94423): counted on TC-13/S28 (the physician sees the raw error, TFA-94745). The provider text a vision failure forwards to the browser (OAT-05/S30) is now suggestion A6. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745): a failed dictation recovery shows the raw Convex error too (usePreRoundAudioRecovery.ts:227, useAudioBackup.ts:95; OAT-03/S19, TC-23/S25).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S19

Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S28 When the AI fails: photo read error, extraction primary-model failure, and the panel's non-default states on desktop and phone

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U15 When a photo read or an extraction fails or is slow, the app retries and then switches to the backup model or shows a clear message that is announced to assistive technology. … (UAT 3.5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U1 Paste and photograph are physician-triggered only. Nothing is read, extracted or written to the chart until the physician pastes or photographs a prior note and saves it, and no prior note is pulled … (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 6; TFA-92591 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital and Nursing Home Pre-Round. ai/vision:scanPriorNote is mocked to fail (like dev's Vertex 404 before PR #102), and on the local stack the primary extraction model is forced to fail

When (a) Photograph → the read fails. (b) Paste → Save & Extract while the primary model fails. (c) Run axe and the phone checks (pixel7, iphone15) with the Paste form open, a saved note expanded, and the photo error shown

Then (a) A clear error appears and is announced (role=alert or a live region). The button leaves 'Reading', nothing is saved, Paste still works and Photograph can be retried. (b) aiCallLog shows a fallback row (Mistral Large 3) and the fields fill without a tap; or, once retries are exhausted, a clear message appears and the pasted note is kept. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.5 ('retries, then switches to the backup model or shows a clear message; never left waiting with nothing') + 3.9 + WCAG 2 A/AA (axe-core violations = 0, visual-checks.ts). On main the photo error line has no role=alert (the extraction error line has one), so a finding is expected

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92591 in progress; TFA-94745 ready for qa

When a prior-note photo read fails on the server, the physician sees raw server text ('[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error … Vertex AI request failed: 404'), and the error is not announced to a screen reader.

Evidence: allure 38253418. (a) The error shows, nothing is saved, and Paste and retry work, but there is no role=alert and a thrown read shows the raw text. (b) Extraction falls back from Haiku x2 to Mistral and fills the fields (pass). (c) Accessibility: low-contrast heading, date and note fields labelled only by placeholder, and on phones the 'Note · <date>' toggle is 276×16 px and the delete button 21×21 px. The raw text breaks TFA-94745 AC 2 / EFS U12 (ungated; EFS S19 not built) and is not in the dev report, the ledger or any knownGaps. The gate for U15 is TFA-92591 (in progress). Observation: a photo read after a saved paste appends to the old paste text.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S28

When the AI fails: photo read error, extraction primary-model failure, and the panel's non-default states on desktop and phone

Tickets: TFA-92591 Previous Notes (carry-forward template) (in progress)

New local lane newspec-b: status failed in newspec-b/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: partly): (a) Chromium: ai/vision:scanPriorNote answered with a failure at the socket after a photo upload (synthetic image); assert a clear error with role=alert or a live region, button leaves 'Reading', nothing saved, Paste works, Photograph retry possible. (b) In-process api harness: real extractPriorNote handler with Haiku failing (throttle ×2) → Mistral answers, diagnostics row model=Mistral fellBackFrom=Haiku; plus UI: Save & Extract fills fields without a tap when the action answers. (c) axe WCAG 2 A/AA + phone checks (pixel7, iphone15 emulation) on Paste form open, a saved note expanded, the photo error shown. After review: (c) also runs axe's target-size rule (WCAG 2.5.8, size or spacing) on the panel; the size-only pageChecks is reported as the matrix's ≥ 24 px rule, not as 2.5.8. — (b) cannot fail the primary model on the live local backend without aiProvider:_set / env set (out of bounds), so the fallback is proven at the provider seam in-process, not end to end; everything else is scripted. Patch keeps needs ['fault-ai'] for that part (check-matrix has no 'partly' testability).

Detail:

Re-run 17:03. (a) both modes, thrown and 'unreadable': error shown, button back to 'Photograph', nothing saved, Paste works, Photograph retry works — but the error has no role=alert / live region (fails U15). The thrown read shows the raw server text (the mock mimics dev's Vertex 404; the app prints it verbatim). (b) Hospital passes: 'Prior note saved, but extraction failed. Expand it and tap Extract Fields to retry.' (role=alert), note kept; Extract Fields then fills imaging/background with no further tap. The primary-model fallback is proven in-process only (extractPriorNote Haiku ×2 → Mistral, diagnostics row Mistral fellBackFrom Haiku with providerMs); end to end it needs aiProvider:_set (out of bounds), so (b) is partly covered. Nursing Home stores the note with no extraction (Q4, recorded). (c) axe color-contrast (serious) on the panel heading in every state and view; date and note fields labelled only by placeholders; under the matrix's ≥ 24 px size rule the 'Note · <date>' toggle (276×16) and the delete button (21×21) are too small on Pixel 7 / iPhone 15 — but axe's target-size rule (WCAG 2.5.8, which allows the spacing exception) finds 0 violations in every state and view, so this is not a WCAG 2.5.8 failure. No sideways scroll, nothing truncated or covered.

Product issue: (1) A failed photo read is not announced to assistive technology (no role=alert / live region), and when the read service errors the physician reads '[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error Uncaught Error: Vertex AI request failed: 404 …' (TC-13 U15). (2) Previous Notes panel: low-contrast heading (axe color-contrast, WCAG 1.4.3) and placeholder-only labels on the date and note fields (WCAG 1.3.1/3.3.2) — TC-13 S28 oracle. Tap targets under the matrix's 24 px rule (16 px-high toggle, 21 px delete) on phones; axe target-size passes (spacing exception), so this is the matrix's rule, not WCAG 2.5.8. Observation: after a pasted note is saved, a photo read appends to the old text in the paste box (the note appears twice).

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our mocked Playwright test and visual-lane states, not written yet): it mocks ai/vision:scanPriorNote with action-observer.ts, needs a local switch that fails the primary extraction model (aiProvider:_set and convex env set are out of bounds) and a make-session.ts fixture for the visual l…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
